pages: Protect Your Power STAY CONNECTED ANYTIME, ANYWHERE! Seamlessly monitor and manage your generator, giving you peace of mind wherever you are. With remote monitoring, you’ll always know your generator is ready when you need it most. Start Monitoring Today! Setup is simple and takes just a few minutes, follow the steps below to get started: Scan the QR Code Open your phone’s camera app and aim it at the QR code. Tap the Link Click on the link that appears to open the setup page. Create Your Account Enter your email, password and additional information. Add Your Generator Follow prompts to choose a subscription and add a generator. Monitor From Anywhere! Access your generator’s status anytime, from any device. SCAN HERE or visit generac.com/monitor to begin monitoring your generator! Enjoy total confidence in power security, protection, and control anytime, anywhere. Visit support.generac.com for additional help or troubleshooting.
